# Montana Knife Company

> > Master Bladesmith Josh Smith's Montana Knife Company crafts premium American-made hunting, tactical, and everyday carry knives with heritage-inspired designs and cryogenic heat-treated 52100 high carbon steel.

Montana Knife Company specializes in fixed-blade and folding knives designed by Master Bladesmith Josh Smith, ranging from hunting and bushcraft models to tactical and culinary applications. The company is known for signature designs like the Speedgoat, Mini Speedgoat 2.0, and Jackstone, with endorsements from outdoor personalities like Cam Hanes and Remi Warren.

## Featured Product Lines

- [MKC Blades](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/pages/mkc-blades): MKC blade product lineup featuring Mini Speedgoat 2.0, Jackstone, and other featured models.
- [THE SPEEDGOAT BLADE](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/the-speedgoat-blade): Speedgoat blade collection made from 52100 high carbon steel with cryogenic heat treatment.
- [MINI-SPEEDGOAT 2.0 FIXED BLADE](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/mini-speedgoat-fixed-blade): Mini Speedgoat 2.0 fixed blade collection by Josh Smith for everyday carry and hunting.
- [JACKSTONE](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/jackstone): Jackstone Canadian belt knife product line for EDC, hunting, and outdoor use.
- [THE BLACKFOOT FIXED BLADES](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/blackfoot-blades): Blackfoot 2.0 fixed blade collection made from 52100 high carbon steel with cryogenic treatment.

## Hunting & Field Knives

- [HUNTING](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/hunting): Hunting knife collection featuring Speedgoat 2.0, Mini Speedgoat 2.0, Jackstone, and The Stockyard.
- [THE STOCKYARD](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/the-stockyard): The Stockyard knife collection featuring hunting and everyday carry models.
- [MKC ELK KNIFE](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/elkhorn-skinner): MKC Elk knife skinner blade designed by Josh Smith for hunting and field use.
- [STONED GOAT 2.0](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/stoned-goat-2-0): Stoned Goat 2.0 ultralight skinner blade for hunting and field skinning.
- [PACKOUT SKINNER](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/packout-skinner): Packout Skinner blade designed by Josh Smith and endorsed by Cam Hanes for hunting.
- [THE SUPER CUB DROP POINT HUNTER](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/super-cub-drop-point-hunter): Super Cub drop point hunter with 5.5" blade for field hunting and outdoor tasks.

## Everyday Carry & Tactical

- [EVERYDAY CARRY](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/everyday-carry): Everyday carry (EDC) knife collection with Mini Speedgoat 2.0, Jackstone, and other portable models.
- [MKC Tactical](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/pages/mkc-tactical): MKC Tactical knife collection featuring WARGOAT and MINI WARGOAT tactical models.
- [FREEZOUT](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/freezout): Freezout waterfowl blade collection for hunting and tactical everyday carry use.

## Specialized Collections

- [MKC CULINARY COLLECTION](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/mkc-culinary-nav): MKC Culinary Collection of kitchen and chef knives for professional and home use.
- [BUSHCRAFT](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/bushcraft): Bushcraft and survival knife collection featuring fixed-blade knives for outdoor and camping use.
- [MKC TRADITIONS](https://www.montanaknifecompany.com/collections/mkc-traditions): MKC Traditions knife line showcasing heritage blade models for hunting and EDC.
